lib/db.ts.purpose: Prisma client initialization with PrismaPg adapter; central DB access for server-side code.

app/api/play/route.ts.purpose: Server route to record a play event: increments track.playCount and upserts userTrackPlay. Revalidates tags.

features/track/track-actions.ts.purpose: Server action to toggle a user's favorite; updates DB and invalidates tags.

features/playlist/playlist-actions.ts.purpose: Server actions for playlist mutations. Create/delete playlist and manage playlistTrack rows; call updateTag.

lib/audio/music-engine.ts.purpose: Procedural music generation using Web Audio API; deterministic per-track synthesis.

lib/audio/audio-scheduler.ts.purpose: Client-side audio scheduling used by PlayerProvider; manages bars, progress, crossfade.
